unlisted_practices: Develop AI tools that provide more accurate information and can identify and counter emotionally charged yet false content that discourages vaccine acceptance.
Balance the development, monitoring, and regulation of AI in public health communication.
Educate the public about the risks and benefits of AI.
Commit to ethical principles and transparency when integrating AI into public health programmes.
Use AI to augment human expertise rather than replace it.

screen.reason: This is an opinion/commentary piece arguing how generative AI should be ethically and responsibly deployed to combat vaccine hesitancy.
